anya_integrations: We shipped a change that normalizes timestamps to minute-floor and zero-trims entitlement ids. Partner told us they'd switch, but they may still be sending seconds that round up.

ingest-bot: pipeline status: last_offset=5012345, recent_errors=3 (timestamp parse / timezone double-markers).

beth_finance: These affect billing for two enterprise invoices due tomorrow. Request invoice-hold until recon completes. Tagging hold now.
